name: Sarracín (Spain)
description: White field with a red stripe near the top, a yellow stripe through the centre and a blue stripe near the bottom, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Sarracín (an eagle, a tree and a bridge above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Sarracín; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Sarracín arms — eagle, tree and bridge above waves
